snippet.title: The actor who turned down Chandler Bing and ghosted Matthew Perry 💔 #shorts  #friends
snippet.description:
Matthew Perry opens up about a heartbreaking chapter with his close friend Craig Bierko, the actor who originally turned down the role of Chandler Bing on 'Friends'. After 'Friends' became a massive global phenomenon, Craig couldn't handle seeing Matthew get rich and famous from the exact role he passed on, and stopped speaking to him for two years. When they finally reunited at 24 years old, Matthew shared a devastating truth about fame and success: "It doesn't do what we all thought it would do." 💔🎬

snippet.title: Bill Hader & Seth Rogen Tricked McLovin For a Whole Year! 😂 #shorts  #superbad  #billhader
snippet.description:
Bill Hader shares a hilarious behind-the-scenes story from the set of 'Superbad' (2007)! 😂
During filming, Bill Hader, Seth Rogen, and Jonah Hill realized how young and naive Christopher Mintz-Plasse (McLovin) was when he didn't recognize the famous quote from the 1986 sci-fi comedy 'Short Circuit'. So, in complete unison, they convinced him that 'Short Circuit' was a 100% serious scientific documentary about a real robot that came to life, and that actor Steve Guttenberg quit acting to become a scientist! McLovin believed it for an entire year. 🤖🎬

snippet.title: Matthew Perry's most embarrassing role before Friends #shorts
snippet.description:
Matthew Perry reveals the most bizarre and embarrassing role he ever took right before landing 'Friends': starring in the failed sci-fi pilot 'LAX 2194'.

During the very same pilot season he auditioned for Chandler Bing, Perry signed on to play a baggage handler at Los Angeles airport in the year 2194 sorting extraterrestrial luggage. snippet.description:

The Pop Legend loved the franchise so much that he refused to play a random alien—he insisted on being an actual Man in Black (Agent M). But on the day of the shoot, nerves got the best of him and he locked himself in his trailer, eventually stepping out in bright red pajamas! 🟥

snippet.title: Matt Damon on Clint Eastwood's 1Take rule! #shorts
snippet.description:

On day one, they shot the very first take. Matt felt good about it but wanted to try an alternative version, so he asked: "Hey boss, do you mind if we do one more?" Clint’s iconic, terrifying response? "Why? You want to waste everybody's time?" 😂

snippet.title: The night Clint Eastwood saved the Oscars! #shorts
snippet.description:
This is one of the craziest live television disasters in Oscar history!

In 1973, Charlton Heston (the man who played Moses) was supposed to read the opening monologue, but his car broke down. With seconds left before going live, the panicked producers begged Clint Eastwood, who was just sitting in the audience, to run backstage and do it cold.

Clint had to read lines written in biblical terms meant for Heston, creating a hilariously awkward moment until Heston finally rushed onto the stage! Watch Clint Eastwood look back at the chaotic night he saved the Academy Awards.
